candidates.name: Western Building Specialties, Inc.
candidates.review_source: BBB A+ rating (letter grade, no review count read)
candidates.partition_evidence: Products page lists section 10160 Toilet Compartments & Shower Stalls (General Partitions, Tex-Lam, Scranton); homepage and Installation page say it offers professional installation for its whole product line with its own crew. No page names partition installation specifically. BBB lists it under Partitions.
red_flags: Partition installation is implied by 'installs all products', not shown in project photos
candidates.reason: Lubbock Division 10 and doors distributor since 1947. It sells toilet compartments and says it installs its entire product line for commercial clients across West Texas and the South Plains. This is the best local lead, but it competes as a partition seller.

license.name: Western Building Specialties, Inc.
license.registry: None applies: Texas has no state contractor license for this work (Office of the Governor, Texas Business Licenses & Permits Guide); the area rule for Lubbock lists no city registration
license.note: Guide read 2026-11-20: 'General contractors are not required to obtain a license to practice in Texas. A general contractor may be subject to local (county or city) requirements.' The area rule gives no Lubbock registration, so there is no registry to check. Company site not opened; nothing recorded about the business itself. A Texas SOS entity search was not run (it needs paid SOSDirect access).
